# Spread Love & Acceptance (The Objective Ledger)

> Spread Love & Acceptance is a young, independent start-up building The Objective Ledger: a free, growing suite of self-help tools for understanding yourself and sharing life kindly with the people around you. It brings together practical relationship tools, gentle games, calm breathing and sound spaces, and a plain-language library, with new tools and content added all the time. Everything you type stays on your device.

Key facts:
- Website: https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ . Free to use; everything opens with a free email sign-up, and much of it needs nothing at all.
- Who it is for: anyone who wants to understand themselves and get along more kindly and fairly with others: partners, families, co-parents, friends, roommates, coworkers and caregivers, and people exploring on their own.
- Themes: self-help, relationships, love, kindness, appreciation, acceptance, reconciliation and repair, calm, peace, harmony, breathing and quiet moments, connection, fairness and the invisible "mental load", and differences in how people are wired.
- The Five Pillars: see the whole load; fix the setup, not the person; read your state first; tune how you send and receive; notice the quiet incentives.
- Privacy: what people type into the tools stays on their own device.
- It is education and self-reflection, not therapy, diagnosis or treatment.
- Mascots: two pups, Tidbit (black mask) and Sugarfoot (white feet). Chat helper: Professor Puddles.
- Status: a young start-up with a working, growing suite; new tools and content are added continually (see https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/whats-new.html).
- Contact: patrick.christian.andrews@gmail.com

## Tools for kinder conversations and fair relationships
- [Free Relationship Help Chat: Ask Professor Puddles](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ask.html): Describe what’s going on in a relationship and get kind, practical next steps and words you could use. Free and private: what you type stays on your device.
- [Is the Chore Split Fair? A Free Calculator (CALC-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/calc01-solvency.html): A free calculator for the household split: time, effort and the invisible jobs, so you can see whether the setup works for everyone.
- [Carrier Wave Decoder](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/carrier-wave-decoder.html): Decode the moment a conversation starts to go wrong, check your state, practice getting back in tune, and look back on the week together.
- [Check-ins in depth — A Safe Room for a Hard Conversation](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/check-ins-in-depth.html): How to hold a check-in: a calm time and setting, acknowledgment before any rebuttal, a rebuttal that does not erase what was heard, a solution that works for.
- [Relationship Check-Ins: A Simple, Kind Weekly Ritual](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/check-ins.html): A short, kind check-in for couples, families and housemates: what went well, what felt heavy, and one small change to try next.
- [Text Thread Reader: Calm Replies After a Fight](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/conversation-reader.html): Paste a text thread and see where it turned, what each of you may be hearing, and calmer replies in your own words. Free and private.
- [The Full Path Package and Report](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/full-path.html): One fillable PDF with every workpaper for your road, and a detailed report written from your answers: findings, things worth a second look, recommendations.
- [Know Your Own Wiring in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/know-yourself-in-depth.html): A plain-language guide to why you react the way you do: lasting wiring, patterns shaped by life and hard experiences, and today’s conditions.
- [Know Your Own Wiring: A Self-Discovery Guide](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/know-yourself.html): Understand how you take in plans, change and feedback, and how to explain what helps you to the people you live and work with.
- [Who Did What This Week? A Simple Chore Tracker](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/lemonade-stand.html): A friendly chore tracker for the week: note who did what, see the balance at a glance, and talk about it without blame.
- [Daily Mood Check-In: How’s Your Weather Today?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quick-checks.html): A 60-second check-in on how you’re doing today, with a gentle forecast for hard talks and a calm pause with something soothing to do.
- [Tone Checker: See How Your Text Will Land](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/signal-translator.html): A free tone checker: type a text or message and see how it may land, what they may hear, and a kinder, clearer way to say it. Private, on your device.
- [A quick snapshot](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/snapshot/): A gentle 2-minute look at how a shared load is set up and how it bends, for partners, families, roommates, co-carers and teams. Not a test or a diagnosis.
- [The 2-minute snapshot](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/snapshot/snapshot-diagnostic-snapshot-interactive.html): Seven quick questions about how a shared load is set up and how it bends under pressure. You get one of four areas, the scoring shown openly, and one small.
- [Turning Toward in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/turning-toward-in-depth.html): The everyday practices that build connection: noticing bids, specific thanks, celebrating good news, the stress-reducing conversation, small rituals, knowing.
- [Turning Toward: 7 Small Habits for Closer Relationships](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/turning-toward.html): Connection grows in small moments. Seven simple practices: notice when someone reaches for you, give specific thanks, and repair gently after a hard moment.
- [Wired Differently in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wired-differently-in-depth.html): How autistic, ADHD, dyslexic, anxious, trauma-wired, highly sensitive and neurotypical people can hear the same sentence in completely different ways, with.
- [Wired Differently: Neurodiversity in Relationships](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wired-differently.html): How different minds can hear the same words differently, and simple ways to share plans, chores and feedback so they land for everyone.
- [Wiring Card](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wiring-card.html): Make a one-page wiring card: how you receive words, what silence means, what to avoid, and how a request should be phrased. Free.

## Worksheets (the Workpaper Suite)
- [Try the workpapers](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/do/): A practice space to try the core worksheets on a worked example before you use your own week. Nothing is saved.
- [Workpaper Playground](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/do/workpaper-playground.html): Practice the core worksheets on a worked example: log a week (WP-01), check a battery (WP-02), name owners (WP-03) and see if the load can last (CALC-01).
- [PROG-01 in depth: The 6-Week Guided Implementation Roadmap](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/prog-01-in-depth.html): PROG-01: Structured, week-by-week curriculum for The Objective Ledger. Integrates chapters, workpapers, podcast episodes, and optional audio.
- [A Six-Week Guided Program for Fairer Chores](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/prog-01.html): Six gentle weeks, one worksheet a week: see the load, give every job an owner, check your batteries and how you talk, then look at what changed.
- [Program Overview in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/program-overview-in-depth.html): How the manuscript chapters map onto the workpapers: what each chapter argues, which tool it pairs with, and what is built today.
- [Program Overview](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/program-overview.html): How the program fits together: the chapters explain the ideas and the worksheets put them to use. It also says plainly what is built and what isn't yet.
- [Suite Index in depth — What's Actually Live](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/suite-index-in-depth.html): An honest index of everything currently live in The Objective Ledger Workpaper Suite.
- [Suite Index](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/suite-index.html): The official list of what’s built today. If something is listed here, it’s live and ready to use. If it isn’t listed, it isn’t live yet.
- [Is the setup working for everyone? (CALC-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/calculators/calc01-solvency.html): The quick CALC-01: type in the totals from your worksheets, for 2 to 8 people, and see in plain words whether the way you share the load is working, with the.
- [REPORT-01 in depth — The Full Read](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/report-01-in-depth.html): Where all your worksheets come together: one place to record each week's numbers, and a report written for you on how they fit together.
- [Your progress, week by week (REPORT-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/report-01.html): One place to type in what your worksheets produced each week, and a report that reads them side by side to show where they agree and where they don’t.
- [WP-01 in depth — Who did what, and kind ways to say no](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-01-in-depth.html): WP-01 in full: the 7-day Field Audit and the expanded guide to kind ways to say no, in one document.
- [Who did what, and kind ways to say no (WP-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-01.html): A one-week log of who did what at home, plus simple scripts for saying “not right now” without starting a fight.
- [WP-02 in depth — How much are you carrying?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-02-battery-stress-meter-in-depth.html): WP-02 in full: a five-question check on yourself that separates the stress you're already carrying from how upset you are about one thing.
- [How much are you carrying? (WP-02)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-02-battery-stress-meter.html): A quick check on yourself that separates how much you are already carrying from how upset you are about this one thing.
- [WP-03 in depth: The RACI Treaty](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-03-raci-treaty-in-depth.html): Purpose: a living agreement that gives every regular household job one owner (the Responsible name), with an optional helper (standing in for Accountable).
- [One owner per job (WP-03)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-03-raci-treaty.html): A shared list that gives every regular household job one clear owner, so you stop re-deciding who does what every week.
- [WP-04 in depth: The Deficit Audit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-04-deficit-audit-in-depth.html): Purpose: a monthly look-back, done together, across four weeks of WP-01 logs (who did what) (WP-01) and your RACI Treaty (WP-03), to find the tasks that keep.
- [What keeps coming back? (WP-04)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-04-deficit-audit.html): Once a month, together, you look back at four weeks of logs to find the jobs that keep slipping, and fix the setup instead of patching it again.
- [WP-04 — The Deficit Audit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-04.html): WP-04 in full: the monthly look-back over four weeks of WP-01 logs (who did what), sorting the jobs that keep slipping.
- [WP-09 in depth: Say it so it lands](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-09-tone-filter-in-depth.html): Purpose: a practical checklist for "retuning" before you respond, putting the radio-frequency idea from Chapter I into everyday practice.
- [Say it so it lands (WP-09)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-09-tone-filter.html): A quick self-check to run before you answer something that landed hard, so what you say is something the other person can actually hear.
- [WP-11 — The Calm-Down Kit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-11.html): WP-11: an earlier version of the Calm-Down Kit, built around calming your senses.
- [WP-13 in depth: The Phase-Locked Loop](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-13-pll-protocol-in-depth.html): Purpose: a short, easy check-in you do every day, named after the electronic circuit that keeps two signals in step with small, steady corrections.
- [The 90-second daily check-in (WP-13)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-13-pll-protocol.html): A 90-second daily check-in that makes small corrections every day, so little things don’t build up into a big weekend argument.
- [Fair Chore Chart: Who Did What (WP-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-01.html): A free chore chart worksheet: note who did what this week, see the split clearly, and find kind ways to say no. For couples, families and roommates.
- [How Much Are You Carrying? A Stress Self-Check (WP-02)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-02.html): A quick self-check of how full your plate feels today, to help you pace a hard talk. A reflection tool, not a test or diagnosis.
- [Who Owns Which Chore? One Owner per Job (WP-03)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-03.html): Give every recurring job one owner from start to finish, so nothing slips and nobody nags. A free household planning worksheet.
- [Mental Load Audit: What Keeps Coming Back? (WP-04)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-04.html): Find the jobs and arguments that keep coming back, see the invisible work behind them, and fix the setup instead of blaming a person.
- [Say It So It Lands: Kinder Wording (WP-09)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-09.html): Turn a hard sentence into one that lands: what you mean, what they may hear, and a calmer way to say it. A free communication worksheet.
- [WP-11 in depth — The Calm-Down Kit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11-in-depth.html): WP-11 in full: a plan made ahead of time for calming down enough to pick a conversation back up, or to put it off honestly.
- [The Sound Toolkit (WP-11 companion)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11-sound-toolkit.html): Three simple background sounds you can try as part of your Calm-Down Kit: a low hum, a soft flutter and brown noise. A matter of taste, not a treatment.
- [Calm-Down Kit: A Plan for Heated Moments (WP-11)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11.html): Make a simple plan for heated moments: your signs, a pause signal, what helps you settle, and how to come back to the talk kindly.
- [90-Second Daily Check-In for Couples (WP-13)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-13.html): A 90-second daily check-in for couples and housemates: how you’re doing, what’s coming up, and one small way to help.

## Calm, breathing and sound
- [Drift: A Calm Visualizer With Soft Tones](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/calm-visualizer.html): Tell Drift how you feel, put on headphones and let slow, dreamy visuals, kind words and gentle tones keep you company for a few quiet minutes.
- [Echoes of Gold — The Companion Album](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/echoes-of-gold.html): Echoes of Gold (The Christian Project): the 11-track album that came before The Objective Ledger, produced by Christian, performing as Loves Journey EP.
- [The Night Garden: A Calm Breathing Game](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/night-garden.html): A peaceful garden at night: breathe slowly to make flowers bloom, guide fireflies into constellations and stack glowing stones. A free, calm game.
- [Pal Cam TV: A Cozy Puppy Cam for Your TV](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pal-cam-tv.html): Two cartoon pups play, nap and explore live on your TV, with calm music and soft place sounds. Free to cast or play full screen.
- [Calm Soundscapes and Relaxing Music](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/soundscapes.html): Calm soundscapes and gentle music: breathing tracks, peaceful ambient pieces and songs about love, acceptance and finding your way back to each other.

## Calm games
- [Daily Crossword Puzzle, Newspaper Style (Free)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/daily-ledger-crossword.html): A free newspaper-style crossword with fair, friendly clues. Play in your browser on any device, at your own pace.
- [Play The Frequency Journey](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-journey-play.html): Guide Sugarfoot and Tidbit through seven gentle, tone-themed worlds to find the Perfect Frequency.
- [The Frequency Journey: A Calm Puzzle Adventure](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-journey.html): Help Tidbit and Sugarfoot find the Perfect Frequency through seven worlds of calm puzzles, riddles and small lessons about patience and harmony.
- [Calm Games for a Busy Mind: Free, No Timers](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pause-and-play.html): Free calm games with no timers and no way to lose: the Night Garden, the Frequency Journey, Word Bloom, crosswords and a word search, with two friendly pups.
- [The Quest Map](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quest.html): A friendly map of the whole program, grouped by the Five Pillars. Each chapter, workpaper, guide, tool, game and library shelf lights up as you explore it.
- [Quiet Crossword: Easy, Gentle Mini Crosswords](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quiet-crossword.html): Small, friendly crosswords with gentle clues, from easy to tricky. Free, calm and no timers: a peaceful puzzle for a few quiet minutes.
- [Quiet Words: A Calm, Free Word Search](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quiet-words.html): A calming word search with soft themes, levels from easy to tricky and no timers. Free to play on your phone or computer.
- [Word Bloom: A Relaxing Letter-Wheel Word Game](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/word-bloom.html): A free, calm word game: spin a wheel of letters and find the hidden words. Levels from easy to tricky, no timers and no ads.

## The book
- [Chapter I in depth: The Radio Frequency Paradigm](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-1-in-depth.html): A model, not a measurement. Nothing in this chapter involves recording, analyzing, or scoring anyone's actual voice — it's a mental picture borrowed from.
- [Why We Get Out of Tune (Chapter I)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-1.html): Chapter I: why kind people still end up resentful at home, and how small mismatches in what we see and expect add up over time.
- [Chapter II in depth: The Epistemic Verdict Engine &…](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-2-in-depth.html): A heuristic self-reflection tool, not a scientific instrument: P(Solvency) reads whether the current household workload arrangement looks sustainable on.
- [Is the Chore Split Working? (Chapter II)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-2.html): Chapter II: a fair way to ask whether the household split is working for everyone, counting time, effort and the invisible jobs.
- [Chapter III in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-3-in-depth.html): Autonomic Saturation and the 7 Ocular Vectors: two self-report tools for how much of a reaction is leftover stress, and which angle each person is seeing a.
- [Stress, Full Tanks and Different Angles (Chapter III)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-3.html): Chapter III: how a full stress tank changes what we hear and say, and why the same moment looks different from each side.
- [Chapter IV in depth: Deontological Parity & Sensory Gating](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-4-in-depth.html): Deontological parity and sensory gating: agreeing which kind of fair your household uses, and giving a comment time to land before you react to it.
- [Two Kinds of Fair at Home (Chapter IV)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-4.html): Chapter IV: equal and fair are not the same. How to find a split that fits your real lives, strengths and seasons.
- [Chapter V in depth: The Deficit Audit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-5-in-depth.html): The Deficit Audit: a monthly look-back that catches the gaps weekly check-ins keep patching, and fixes the arrangement, not either person.
- [The Monthly Relationship Look-Back (Chapter V)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-5.html): Chapter V: a calm monthly look-back to see what changed, celebrate it, and adjust the setup before resentment builds.
- [Preface in depth: Unbilled Debt](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/preface-in-depth.html): Every household runs a set of books nobody agreed to keep. This preface explains the unseen work of a shared life, why writing it down is not keeping score.
- [The Work Nobody Sees: Invisible Labor at Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/preface.html): The preface: the planning, remembering and noticing that keeps a home running, why it goes unseen, and how seeing it changes everything.

## The Professor’s Library and further reading
- [The Frequency Framework in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-framework-in-depth.html): How any relationship runs on five different rhythms, and the beat frequency that creates friction when they drift apart.
- [The Frequency Framework](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-framework.html): Two people can each run on their own rhythm for money, rest, decisions, talking and values.
- [Stories from Philosophy in depth](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/learn/index-in-depth.html): Twelve real stories from philosophy on knowing yourself and living well with others, retold in plain language and connected to the chapters, workpapers and.
- [Stories from Philosophy](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/learn/): Twelve old stories from philosophy, retold in plain words. They help you know yourself, see the other person more clearly, and keep a ledger without letting.
- [Relationship Psychology Library, in Plain English](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library.html): Hundreds of plain-language entries on relationships, conflict, kindness, gratitude, emotions, stress, calm and wiring, with honest notes on the evidence.
- [Calm and Attention, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/calm.html): Slow breathing, mindfulness, nature, music, breaks, phones, mind-wandering and flow, with modest, honest claims.
- [Communication Skills: Talking and Listening](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/communication.html): Listening, I-statements, validation, feedback, questions, texting and the other everyday skills of being understood.
- [Conflict Resolution in Relationships, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/conflict.html): Negotiation, de-escalation, repair, apology, mediation and fair process, from research and practice.
- [Kindness, Gratitude and Connection](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/connection.html): Gratitude, good news, self-compassion, loneliness, friendship, kindness and the small rituals that keep people close.
- [Understanding Feelings and Emotions](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/emotions.html): What emotions are, how people regulate them, naming feelings, shame and guilt, anger, rumination, grief and resilience.
- [Fairness and the Mental Load at Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/fairness.html): Equity, the second shift, the mental load, invisible work, and why we each think we do more.
- [Family, Money and Big Life Changes](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/life.html): Family systems, in-laws, co-parenting, new babies, stepfamilies, money, moving, ageing parents, holidays and the big transitions of life.
- [Motivation, Habits and Change](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/motivation.html): Why people do things, how habits form, procrastination, perfectionism, mindset, self-esteem, values and making change stick.
- [How Relationships Work: What Research Says](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/relationships.html): What decades of research on couples, families and friends say about what keeps people close.
- [Stress and the Body, in Plain English](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/stress.html): The stress response, allostatic load, the window of tolerance, polyvagal theory and its critics, sleep, hunger and burnout.
- [Fair Systems for Teams and Households](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/teams.html): Borrowed tools from project management, safety science and teamwork: ownership, blameless reviews, checklists and why shared jobs slip.
- [Common Thinking Traps, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/thinking.html): The biases and mental shortcuts that make us assume the worst, remember selectively and misread each other.
- [Neurodiversity: Differences in Wiring](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/wiring.html): Neurodiversity, the double empathy problem, autism, ADHD, sensitivity, personality and chronotype.
- [Observational Podcast: The Kane and Christian Experience](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/podcast-index.html): The Objective Ledger podcast series: episodes exploring workpapers, chapters, and real-world applications of the framework with Kane and Christian.
- [Further Reading](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/reading.html): Hand-picked articles from Psychology Today, Greater Good Magazine, The Gottman Institute and other trusted sources, sorted by topic and by the Five Pillars.
